card.architecture: FireRed-Image-Edit 1.1 (FireRedTeam) — ~20B Qwen-Image-Edit-style MMDiT; Qwen2.5-VL encoder + Qwen-Image VAE. Runs the Qwen-Image-Edit topology (TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus + ModelSamplingAuraFlow shift 3.1) via clip_type qwen_image. Q5_K_M GGUF.
card.summary: FireRed's instruction editor on a ~20B Qwen-class backbone, Q5_K_M GGUF (~14.9GB) for 24GB fit. Strong identity/scene consistency and text; reuses the Qwen2.5-VL encoder and Qwen-Image VAE already installed.
use_cases: high-quality instruction editing (add/remove/replace, recolour, background swap)
text edits with strong glyph fidelity
card.pick_when: You want a high-quality ~20B instruction editor and can spend ~40 steps for best fidelity.

prompt.guidance: Provide an input image + imperative instruction.
prompt.example: (with input image) Put a red baseball cap on her and change the background to a beach
prompt.overview: Plain natural-language edit instructions. Semantic (high-level, identity-preserving) and appearance (precise local) edits; multi-image references via image2/image3. Recommended ~40 steps at CFG 4.

negative.note: Runs CFG ~4 with an empty negative.

ui_help.note: Edits an existing image from an instruction.

edit_use_cases: high-quality instruction editing on a ~20B backbone: add/remove/replace, recolour, background, relight; strong consistency and text

reference.hint: Your photo is image 1; your attached references are image 2 and image 3. Refer to them by number.
